description: Read-only auth audit that checks anonymous viewer whoami status and configured YDB CLI tenant access, using root credentials when rootPasswordFile is configured. Use after auth hardening or password rotation to verify the expected posture.

configPath.description: Absolute path to an explicit local-ydb config file. Missing, unreadable, oversized, or invalid explicit files fail closed instead of using defaults.

profile.description: Named profile from local-ydb.config.json. Defaults to config.defaultProfile.

name: local_ydb_auth_check
